title: The receipt is not printing
text: Most of the time, the printer is not selected yet or the paper size is wrong. The sale is still saved, so you can print the receipt again later.
steps: Click Sidebar > Point of Sale, then Click More Options > Printer Setup.
Select your printer and set the Paper Width to match your paper roll. Most small printers use 58mm, while wider ones use 80mm.
Click Test Print and check that the printer is on, has paper, and is connected properly.
To print the receipt again, open More Options > View Sales History, select the sale, and click Re-print Receipt.

title: The customer display is empty or shows the wrong cart
text: A customer display on a second computer only works once that register is added as a terminal. Until then it stays empty.
steps: Click Sidebar > Settings, then Terminals. Check if the register terminal is in the list.
If it is not, open Point of Sale on that computer. Pick Register as new terminal and type a name, like Counter 1.
Do this on every Point of Sale. Two registers must never share one terminal.
Open the customer display again. It should follow the cart as you scan.

title: A staff member cannot open a page
text: Each staff account can only open pages that are allowed for that role. If a page or menu is missing, the permission for that page is turned off.
steps: Click Sidebar > Users & Security.
Double-click the staff member, then open the Permissions tab.
Turn on the pages they need and click Save.
Ask them to sign out and sign in again.
If many people need the same access, go to Settings > Roles & Permissions, and create a role for them.

title: A product is missing at the register
text: Products are assigned to a branch. If an item is missing at the register, it is often inactive for this branch or it was created for another branch.
steps: Click Sidebar > Products > Product List, and search for the item.
Check the Active filter. If needed, edit the product and turn Active Status back on.
Check whether the barcode matches what the scanner reads by scanning it into the search box.
If the product exists only on another branch, click Import Products and copy it to this branch.

title: A report is empty
text: Most empty reports are caused by the date range. Many reports start on today only, so older dates may look empty unless you choose a wider time period.
steps: Click Sidebar > Reportings > Pick the report you want.
Click the date range button and choose the days you want, then click Generate Report.
Check the branch name at the top. A report usually shows one branch unless you choose All Branch.
Clear any product, cashier, or customer filter still in the filter bar.
If it is still empty, check whether your account is allowed to view reports under Users & Security.

title: Tinker will not give me numbers
text: Tinker can only show numbers that your account is allowed to see. If it gives you a guide instead of a result, your account probably does not have permission to open reports.
steps: Ask an owner to open Users & Security, open your account, and turn on Reports.
Include the time period in your question, such as today, this week, or this month.
Sign out and sign in again so the new permission takes effect.
